description: This file implements extended regular expression matching and search functionality within the GNU C Library, providing core functions like regexec, re_match, re_search and internal mechanisms for DFA-based regex matching, subexpression handling, backreference support, and state set manipulations.

methods.name: int regexec(const regex_t * __restrict preg,const char * __restrict string,size_t nmatch,regmatch_t pmatch[],int eflags)
methods.description: Searches for a match of the compiled regex pattern in a string, considering execution flags, and fills the match offsets if requested.

methods.name: int re_match(struct re_pattern_buffer * bufp,const char * string,int length,int start,struct re_registers * regs)
methods.description: Matches a regex pattern against a string at a specific start index, returning match length or -1 if no match.

methods.name: re_search
methods.description: Searches for a match within a range starting at a specific index.

methods.name: re_match_2
methods.description: Matches a pattern against concatenated strings with separate lengths.

methods.name: re_search_2
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in concatenated strings with range control.

methods.name: void re_set_registers(struct re_pattern_buffer * bufp,struct re_registers * regs,unsigned num_regs,regoff_t * starts,regoff_t * ends)
methods.description: Configures regex match registers to specific buffers for storing match positions.
